narrative.overview: Teact ships React components to Telegram, so the site is set like freight paperwork: a kraft-card ground, white label stock laid on top, ruled fields with condensed caps for their names, monospace for codes and tracking numbers, and one safety-orange mark for what matters.
keyCharacteristics: Label stock on kraft; ink borders define every container.
Square corners everywhere except Telegram's own chat bubbles in previews.
Field labels in condensed caps; values in Archivo or Martian Mono.
One accent (safety orange) for the primary action, active markers and selection.
Telegram blue appears only inside rendered Telegram previews.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Safety orange marks a single thing per region: the primary action, the active item, or a measured value. It never fills a section.

rules.name: The Telegram Is Quoted Rule
rules.body: Telegram's own colours appear only where Telegram is being shown, never in the site chrome.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width and weight axes, not from adding faces.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: A shadow means a separate sheet of label stock. Never put a shadowed box inside another shadowed box.

dos: Do set every container as label stock with a 2px ink border and square corners.
Do name fields in condensed label caps (wdth 75, 0.08em, uppercase) and put values in Archivo or Martian Mono.
Do show rendered Telegram output with TelegramPreview next to the code that produces it.
Do keep docs body text at 68ch and let the frame, not the column, carry the world.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, blur or glass.
Don't round corners outside Telegram previews.
Don't use Telegram blue in site chrome or safety orange as a fill for a whole section.
Don't nest a shadowed box inside another shadowed box.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings; field labels belong inside labels only.
